scope: Make hygiene observation freshness independent of the current scan round-trip duration.
intended_behavior: Freshness is evaluated against one timestamp captured before the worker scan and pressure publications begin.
An observation exactly one reconcile interval old at pass start is accepted even when the current scan round-trip consumes time.
An observation older than one reconcile interval at pass start is rejected as stale.
out_of_scope: Implementing or wiring the HygieneObservationSource tracked by fp-20aa.
Changing hygiene domain policy or canonical result schemas.
Waiting synchronously for a worker response or widening the freshness interval.
